run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the LCS formed by consecutive segments of at least length k between two strings
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming algorithm that finds LCS with minimum consecutive segment length k

review_f_gold: review the f_gold function and its test harness for correctness across the ten parameter sets
